picks.title: 6 Ayat. One Hidden Connection. | Surah Yunus - Tadabbur Series | Sheikh Mohamed Eid Almuhairi #AMAU
picks.summary: When reading the Quran, you may understand the meaning of every Ayah you pass through, and still miss what the Surah is showing you as a whole. Why does Surah Yunus move from the challenge of the Qur'an, to the mission of the Messenger ﷺ, to Allah governing every affair, then suddenly to resurrection, punishment, the sun and the moon? These are not disconnected ideas. In this episode of the Tadabbur series, Sheikh Mohamed Eid Almuhairi begins Surah Yunus and shows how seemingly separate verses start building towards something much bigger.
